invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null TiledMap object constructed and returned on all paths.
The local variable 'map', which is returned, is explicitly a TiledMap.
Immediately before returning, the method assigns a non-null Array<TextureAtlas> to the owned resources of the map.
Method calls like resolve(fileName) and getAtlasFileHandle expect a non-null fileName to function, so it is likely required.
The method accesses parameter.textureMinFilter and parameter.textureMagFilter, so it must be non-null.
